title: Read a C++ standard tag
prompt: A build reports the numeric __cplusplus tag. Return true if it names C++20 or a later standard. An older or zero tag returns false. Do not depend on this compiler’s own tag while testing the function.

tests.label: Older C++17
tests.hint: A smaller tag is too old.

tests.label: Absent tag
tests.hint: Zero is not a modern standard.

hints: Compare the numeric value, including the boundary.
>= means greater than or equal to.
explanation: __cplusplus is a compile-time macro in real code. Passing a numeric tag to a function lets a small unit test exercise the boundary independently.
chapterTitle: Creating a Complete C++ Development Environment
